headline: Cogna Shares Drop Over 12% After Citi Cuts Rating to Sell
summary: Cogna shares fell more than 12% after Citigroup downgraded the stock to sell and slashed its price target from R$ 2.50 to R$ 1.20.
why: Analyst downgrades and price target revisions by major investment banks directly impact market sentiment and institutional share allocations.

impacts.name: Cogna Educacao S.A.
impacts.why: Citi cut the stock to sell and lowered the price target.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A broker downgrade to sell alongside a slashed price target drove a sharp sell-off in Cogna shares.
